newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cereals experts due to fix peripheral tenders.
newsitem.headline: EU cereals experts due to fix peripheral tenders.

text.p: BRUSSELS, Oct 29 - The European Union's cereals management committee will fix the November rate for aid for supplies to peripheral regions on Thursday, an EU official said on Tuesday.
"The aid rates for peripherals will be fixed together with the standing refunds for rice for November," the official said.
The committee will also discuss and may vote on a request from Finland to add a new intervention centre to the official EU list, the offcial added.
